blocks.title: Start from last year's exam
blocks.text: Most JABSOM assessments are built by duplicating the previous year's exam. That keeps question order, categorization, and scoring setup intact.

blocks.text: Students can highlight and strikethrough text in Examplify. This is on by default but can be turned off per assessment under Options.

blocks.title: Leave text highlighting on
blocks.text: JABSOM keeps highlighting enabled for all exams.
Exam review controls whether students can see the questions and their answers after submitting. You configure this before posting under the Exam Review tab.

blocks.title: Choose the review setting before posting
blocks.text: You cannot change the exam review setting after the assessment is posted. Decide up front whether students will see their answers immediately, on a delayed date, or not at all.
After posting, the assessment takes 5 to 10 minutes to appear in the Examplify app on iPads. Plan accordingly when testing before exam day.

blocks.title: OME posts your exam
blocks.text: Do not post your own exam unless OME has asked you to.
